name: Spirit Gathering Pill
description: A jade-green pill smelling of pine. Restores qi.

name: Minor Healing Pill
description: A bitter brown pill that knits small wounds.

name: Iron Skin Pill
description: A heavy, metallic pill that hardens the body. Permanent +1 ATK.

name: Bamboo Viper Fang
description: Curved, hollow, faintly green. Used by alchemists for venom-resist pills.

name: River Eel Skin
description: A supple black hide. Tanners pay for it; armorers more so.

name: Rusty Dao Saber
description: A bandit's curved blade. More rust than steel.

name: Spirit Stone Pouch
description: A small pouch of low-grade spirit stones. Heavy with promise.

name: Frost Wolf Pelt
description: A pale gray pelt that exhales cold even in summer.

name: Frost Wolf Fang
description: A long curved fang frosted with cold qi.

name: Traveler's Robe
description: A plain hempen robe, dust-resistant and unremarkable.

name: Bamboo Qi Crystal
description: A green-veined shard of crystallized bamboo qi. Powerful catalyst for cultivation.

name: Old Hermit's Kettle
description: A clay kettle that brews a tea of strange clarity.

name: Sutra of Empty Sleeves
description: A worn manuscript bound in pale silk. Reading it grants insight.
